$comment: Closed set of semantic anchor roles. Owner of the type lists: story-bake (it resolves roles in the page and in Node). The role NAMES are a contract (schema enum); changing a name is a showrunner decision. story-validator reads this file to check that a beat's anchor (or one of its fallbacks) resolves in the beat's house. Item types are the HouseSpec `items[].type` values (assets/ catalog); zones are `site` zone types. Types are listed in preference order.

builtin.street: The public street in front of the lot. Always resolves (lot frontage).
builtin.front-door: The front door of the house. Always resolves (spec.entry / frontDoor).
builtin.core: The Companion Core (spec.hero). Always resolves. Its surface is a shelf or a desk; its room varies (see casting.json coreSpot).
builtin.room: The centre of the beat's room (use with anchor.room).

universalNote: These resolve in all 30 homes. Every other role needs a fallback chain that ends in one of these, or the beat's house must be named in casting.json as having it. The validator fails a beat whose anchor and fallbacks all miss.
